variants.headline: Grant programme passes over needy districts
variants.body: A government grant programme has passed over districts that needed it. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Need goes unanswered in grant allocation
variants.body: Districts in need were passed over by a government grant programme. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Government grants miss the districts in need
variants.body: A government grant allocation has overlooked the districts that needed support. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
